lines.text: Jesus tells Sardis it has a reputation for being alive, yet it is dead, and to wake up.
Jesus says that if Sardis does not wake up, He will come like a storm.
A few people in Sardis have not soiled their garments, and the one who overcomes will be dressed in white.
Jesus, who holds the key of David, tells the church in Philadelphia He has placed an open door before them.
Jesus will make the overcomer a pillar in God's temple and write on him the name of God's city, Jericho.
